resolution: Fixed the startup regression introduced by req_3333's row-relative fill palette base. The ground shader composes the generated fill catalog into a different D-buffer contract and intentionally neutralizes mat_pal; its loud drift guard still searched for the former D[5] count line, so module initialization threw before the dev host could establish a last-good bundle. The guard now targets D[mat_data_base + 5u], preserving baked ground colors while packed Paint thumbnails retain row-relative palettes. Added explicit regression coverage proving the composed ground formula contains the neutralized count and no live row-relative palette read. The groundFormula suite passes 6/6, the editor bundle succeeds, and the full ReleaseFast editor build completes. Cart-side hot reload only; no native restart required.
